What the record derives instead. Scenario.record (scenario.dart:150-173) counts callReceipts and gives `hitRatePct: settled == 0 ? null : (right * 100 + settled ~/ 2) ~/ settled`. The current AC3 test (trader_record_test.dart:323-331) never reads the card figure. It only checks `inPanel(pair.$2, find.text('Hit rate 67%'))`, and `grep accuracy app/test` finds nothing, so a stored figure passes.
